items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Wynton Kelly in the context of a hypothetical alliance with Miles Davis, but JJ Johnson only responds with general confusion ('I don't know. I wonder.') and does not confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Wynton Kelly.

ctx.x: And, I think it was Wynton Kelly. I always regretted [that] you were under contract with Columbia, and Miles was under contract with Columbia. Why did no record ever come out of that alliance?
Isn’t that weird? That’s weird. I don’t know. I wonder. That’s a strange happening and a strange occurrence. Yeah. I, too, wonder.
